title: 1RB0LD_0RC1RD_1LA1RA_1LE0LE_1RF0LA_0RA--- never halts: DeepMind's Lean proof in cryptids pull request 37, compiled here
text: Open pull request 37 to google-deepmind/cryptids (21 November) adds 21 single-file BB(6) Lean proofs; all 21 build here with only the standard axioms, and each transition table matches its machine. One machine was open on our pages and is now decided: its proof keeps only a lower bound on the 4/3 counter and proves the right-end excursion safe for every tail, using a 578-node certificate of summary lemmas checked by Lean's kernel. The other 20 confirm verdicts we already had.
